area: web host, launcher, sdk, tools (web/**, sdk/**, tools/**, ops/**, package.json)
summary:
Pixel-Garden's web/sdk/tools area (28,612 lines of JS) is the most complete 'NFT mints a website' implementation among the repos. The site is a single HTML host built by tools/build-kernel.mjs, gzipped and radix-85 encoded (tools/host-encoding.mjs) so it survives inside a <script> tag, published as raw ArchiveFactory chunk contracts (23,000-byte chunks, 32 per leaf, 16 leaves per directory) and frozen once by PixelGardenKernel.freezeHost (publisher-only, before first mint, <=196,608 bytes). Kernel.document(id) returns those exact bytes plus '<script>window.PIXEL_CONTEXT={chainId,contract,tokenId}</script></body></html>'; document(id,string) is the ERC-6860 overload so web3://KERNEL:CHAIN/document/ID/string!index.html resolves; tokenURI wraps document(id) as a base64 animation_url inside a percent-encoded JSON data URI (ContentCartridge.gardenMetadata, with the verbatim rationale that re-encoding the whole HTML would exceed RPC gas caps). A separate static HTTPS reader (web/launcher) exists only to recover and verify that on-chain host against a build-pinned __HOST_HASH__ before executing it, swapping the DOM with DOMParser/replaceWith rather than document.write so EIP-1193 listeners survive.

Ownership gating is read-from-chain and enforced-on-chain: GardenClient.refresh() (web/kernel/client.mjs:120) batches ownerOf, custodyEpoch, account/grip, accountReady and refuses to proceed unless both ERC-6551 accounts pass kernel.isCanonicalAccount (exact CREATE2 + ERC-1167 runtime hash); owns = connected account === owner (client.mjs:153); every write passes operation() (client.mjs:206) which re-checks chain, account, custody epoch, cartridge activation and simulates before the durable transaction journal sends. No login signature, no backend. Authority itself lives in the kernel and in ReachAccount's epoch-checked typed withdrawals, seals and exact-recipe sessions; custody epoch bumps on every transfer so a buyer can never replay a seller's prepared call.

The host is at 99.8% of its cap, so the project invented two escape hatches: hash-pinned 'trusted workspaces' (large UIs archived separately, verified with verifyHostModule against build-time SHA-256 + byte count, then evaluated with new Function in the host realm) and sandboxed cartridges (iframe sandbox=allow-scripts, injected CSP with connect-src 'none', MessageChannel capability bridge limited to 120 req/min, 4 concurrent, 40,000-char JSON, typed methods gated by manifest capabilities). The SDK supplies a canonical release format (pixel.garden.release/1), pinned-block reorg-checked recovery for every feature, durable transaction/publication/state checkpoints persisted before wallet access, a complete messaging stack (P-256 ECDH + HKDF + AES-GCM whispers, X25519 Double Ratchet with chain-authenticated handshake, PBKDF2-310,000 sealed backups, EIP-712 identity attestations), and finance recipes for Uniswap v3/v4 swaps, swap-to-lock, token + v4 hook launchpad with CREATE2 flag mining, presales, OTC, vesting sales and a systemd maturity keeper.

For the GOAL, reuse verbatim the archive format/chain I/O, host encoding, discovery pager, whisper/ratchet/sealed-packet crypto, wallet discovery and read console; adapt the build pipeline, reader, GardenClient operation guard, transaction/publication journals, recipe/session SDK and launchpad/swap/lock SDKs; drop the board-specific analytics, 4D studio/worlds art stack and the legacy web/host.mjs line. Known weaknesses: HTTPS reader and read RPC remain trust dependencies, no public-chain deployment, browser-only secret storage, mainnet-only Uniswap config, and a ~200 KB data-URI tokenURI that some marketplaces will truncate.

components.name: tools/compile.mjs
components.purpose: solc-js 0.8.36 viaIR runs=1 cancun compile of src/, EIP-170/initcode gates, reproducible runtime hashes (bytecodeHash:none) pinned into the kernel constructor
key_functions: size gate L179/L193: runtimeBytes > 24576 || initcodeBytes > 49152 throws
design_decisions: Pin the exact Content runtime without embedding another complete copy in Kernel initcode. Compile from the same sources/settings; never accept a caller-supplied identity hash.
security_invariants: Kernel only accepts cartridge runtimes whose keccak matches compile output
components.reuse_notes: Keep the pinned-runtime-hash constructor pattern for a modular kernel.

components.name: tools/host-encoding.mjs
components.purpose: Radix-85 codec (printable ASCII minus quote/backslash/angle/backtick) for gzip host payload inside <script>
design_decisions: No HTML-hazardous characters so the payload needs no escaping

components.name: tools/build-kernel.mjs
components.purpose: Bundle web/kernel/host.mjs, gzip+radix85, emit bootstrap, package cartridges (<=262,144 B) and host (<=196,608 B), compute trusted-workspace digests (web/kernel/trusted.json)
key_functions: bootstrap string with DOMContentLoaded wait and 'Host recovery failed' fallback
design_decisions: Optional closing tags are supplied by Kernel.document, after its bound identity context.
Only these exact sandbox entrypoints may request unpublished local trade memories.
security_invariants: Bootstrap declares nothing at global scope
components.reuse_notes: Pipeline shape is reusable; cartridge list is project-specific.

components.name: tools/build-launcher.mjs
components.purpose: esbuild the HTTPS reader with __HOST_HASH__ injected, emits dist/launcher.html, launcher-chunks/*, garden-sw.js, garden.webmanifest
design_decisions: Reader is a verifier, not a mirror
security_invariants: Only exact pinned host hash runs

components.name: tools/fixture-kernel.mjs
components.purpose: Deploy ERC-6551 registry runtime, ArchiveFactory, cartridges, kernel [10000, content, keccak(Market..Presale)], freeze host, mint, assert tokenURI->animation_url->document round trip; writes dist/deployment.json
design_decisions: Development-only connection metadata is outside the immutable production host.

components.name: tools/recover-cartridges.mjs
components.purpose: CLI: with RPC + token id, recover host document, every cartridge, journal, rooms, locks, presales, OTC, launches and history to disk
design_decisions: Every feature has a no-UI recovery path

components.name: tools/verify-source.mjs
components.purpose: Recompile a contract from source with pinned compiler and compare exact runtime bytes (Hook Inspector)
key_functions: L19 rejects malformed hex or >24,576 bytes

components.name: tools/maturity-keeper.mjs + ops/maturity-keeper.service + sdk/maturity-keeper.mjs
components.purpose: systemd keeper that signs only executeSale for matured vesting-sale recipes, journals before broadcast, enforces caps, never resends
design_decisions: One gas payer, one durable journal. Never authorizes, changes a route, or pays a different recipient.
security_invariants: Confirmed-receipt reorg blocks subsequent nonce use

components.name: tools/package-cartridge.mjs, tools/rpc-relay.mjs, tools/dev.mjs
components.purpose: Package a module app into release format; allowlisted read-only JSON-RPC relay for browser tests; dev server over fixture

components.name: web/launcher (reader)
components.purpose: Static HTTPS page that lists owned tokens, mints with seed, recovers prior mints by nonce, and runs the on-chain host only after hash verification; SW caches shell only
design_decisions: Only an exact build-pinned host can run on this origin. Neither arbitrary token metadata nor query-provided HTML is executable. Cartridges stay sandboxed.
document.write/open removes wallet message listeners. Replace the inert DOM and explicitly start only the already verified bootstrap, preserving providers.
security_invariants: Never executes token metadata or query HTML
components.reuse_notes: Keep DOM-swap trick, pinned hash, SW-shell-only.

components.name: web/kernel/host.mjs
components.purpose: Immutable host runtime: workspace menu (24 workspaces/20 boards), holdings, Reach/Grip, seals/sessions, cartridge sandbox + bridge, trusted workspace loading
design_decisions: Cartridges get no network (connect-src 'none'); all data via capability bridge
security_invariants: Bridge accepts messages only from activeFrame.contentWindow
transaction.propose never signs; routes to client.operation()

components.name: web/kernel/client.mjs (GardenClient)
components.purpose: Wallet connect, ownership/account refresh, operation guard, send with durable journal, content install/activate, state save
key_functions: refresh() L120 (ownerOf L131, custodyEpoch L132, accountReady L135, isCanonicalAccount x2 L141-142)
design_decisions: Account binding failed thrown unless both TBAs canonical
security_invariants: Every write rechecks chain, account, custody epoch, activation, simulates
components.reuse_notes: The operation() guard is the core of connect->verify->use.

components.name: web/kernel trusted-*.mjs + sdk/host-modules.mjs
components.purpose: Hash-pinned native workspace loaders: recover archive, verifyHostModule against build digest, then new Function(source+';return PixelX;')()
design_decisions: Recovery proves what was published. This separate check proves it is the host author's exact code.
security_invariants: Exact SHA-256 + byte count + path + MIME
components.reuse_notes: Escape hatch for EIP-170 front-end size without an upgrade key.

components.name: web/kernel/wallet-choice.mjs, transaction-store.mjs, publications.mjs, mint-seed.mjs, read-console.mjs, a11y.mjs
components.purpose: EIP-6963 discovery; IndexedDB journal under Web Locks; publication checkpoints; seeded mint; send-less pinned console; accessibility
security_invariants: read console rejects sends, expressions, oversized slots

components.name: web/cartridge-api.mjs
components.purpose: Cartridge-side bridge client over MessagePort

components.name: sdk/archive/format.mjs
components.purpose: Release manifest schema, canonical JSON, limits, packaging, verification, dependency graph, chunk planning
design_decisions: Content-addressed chunks deduplicated across releases
security_invariants: 16 KiB manifest, 64 releases, depth 16, 64 MiB/8 MiB

components.name: sdk/archive/chain.mjs + hash.mjs + host-document.mjs
components.purpose: Publish/recover archives and content editions via ArchiveFactory/OnchainApp/Directory; rebuild exact host document
design_decisions: Never trust an address from a resume file or mapping without checking exact bytes.
Recover only canonical readers at a pinned block. No unbounded readAll or execution.
Rebuilding it from verified inputs avoids trusting a separate RPC response for active HTML.

components.name: sdk/archive/publication.mjs + sdk/state.mjs + sdk/transactions.mjs
components.purpose: Durable publication/state/transaction checkpoints persisted before broadcast, classified inspection, read-only merges
design_decisions: Checkpoints are untrusted data. They never contain a wallet key or executable task list.
A saved hash is evidence to inspect, never authority to skip a transaction.
Recompute every call from the package, replay confirmed exact calls, and persist BEFORE broadcast.
Import cannot erase newer local evidence and accidentally mint the same edition twice.

components.name: sdk/launcher.mjs + sdk/discovery.mjs
components.purpose: Garden URL (web3://) codec, mint receipt parsing, owned-token paging, host recovery with pinned hash, starter install; shared pinned-block log pager
design_decisions: Deliberately a narrow Garden URL parser, not a general web3 interpreter. Do not use URL.port: EVM chain IDs are not TCP ports and may exceed 65535.
Hash checks detect corrupt recovery; they are not consensus proofs against a lying RPC.

components.name: sdk/whispers.mjs
components.purpose: Whispers v1 DMs: P-256 ECDH -> HKDF-SHA-256 -> AES-256-GCM with chain-bound scope AAD; PBKDF2 key backups
design_decisions: Browser-native encryption. Private keys never enter an application frame, RPC or contract.

components.name: sdk/whisper-ratchet.mjs
components.purpose: Whispers v2: X25519 classical Double Ratchet with chain-authenticated offer/accept/complete handshake
design_decisions: State transitions are copy-on-success. The caller MUST durably replace encrypted state before submitting a ciphertext or exposing plaintext

components.name: sdk/social.mjs + sdk/social-board.mjs + sdk/sealed-packets.mjs
components.purpose: EIP-712 identity attestations, room/post/reaction recovery, bounded attachments, conversation history, passphrase-sealed journal packets

components.name: sdk/financial-recipes.mjs + locks.mjs + swap-lock.mjs
components.purpose: Typed Reach recipes for v3/v4 swap, launch, exit; lock terms/vesting; swap-to-lock with note commitment; session exposure
design_decisions: Exact recipes, never general executors

components.name: sdk/launchpad.mjs + launch.mjs + liquidity.mjs + presale.mjs
components.purpose: Token + v4 hook creation with CREATE2 flag mining, launch checkpoints, LP seeding math, presales with vesting and attempt reconciliation
design_decisions: Browser does not compile Solidity; imports artifacts/initcode
salts bind chain/kernel/garden/nonce
components.reuse_notes: Mainnet addresses in config/ethereum.json need per-chain variants.

components.name: sdk/otc.mjs + estate.mjs + continuity.mjs + vesting-sales.mjs
components.purpose: OTC two-party escrow reads/plans, rentals, inheritance states, vesting sale recipes/commitments

components.name: sdk analytics readers (history-page, history-checkpoints, hook-inspector, *-discovery, *-accounting, external-metadata, asset-details)
components.purpose: Pinned-block, reorg-checked, bounded readers with replayable checkpoints; hook flag/proxy/runtime inspection; bounded image validators
design_decisions: Zero and no-answer kept distinct

components.name: web/kernel studio/worlds/art stack
components.purpose: 4D procedural geometry, synthesized audio, three world cartridges, 20-board visual language
design_decisions: visuals derive only from on-chain visualSeed

components.name: legacy web/host.mjs, finance.mjs, journal.mjs, rpc.mjs, garden-game.mjs, tools/build.mjs, tools/fixture.mjs, sdk/packages.mjs
components.purpose: Pre-kernel integrated host (96 KiB cap) and 4 KiB-chunk package format

standards_implemented: ERC-6551 (canonical registry 0x000000006551c19487814612e58FE06813775758, exact ERC-1167 runtime check)
ERC-1271 (verified, never signed by session keys)
Uniswap v3 and v4 (hooks, Permit2, PositionManager)
unique_ideas: Kernel.document(id) = frozen archive bytes + injected PIXEL_CONTEXT script + closing tags; one archive serves every token
tokenURI percent-encodes only the JSON envelope and base64-encodes the HTML once to stay under RPC gas caps
Radix-85 gzip transport with the decoder stringified into the on-chain bootstrap
HTTPS reader as verifier: build-pinned __HOST_HASH__, DOMParser/replaceWith swap preserving wallet listeners, SW caches shell only
Hash-pinned trusted workspaces loaded via new Function after verifyHostModule to escape EIP-170 for the front-end without an upgrade key
Sandboxed cartridges: iframe allow-scripts + injected CSP connect-src 'none' + MessageChannel capability bridge with rate/size limits
isCanonicalAccount check before trusting any TBA; custody epoch increments on every transfer (including self-transfer)
Exact-recipe sessions with recipeHash and bounded uses; sessionExposure shows worst-case spend
Durable transaction journal persisted before wallet access; classified inspectTransaction states; never auto-resend
Chain-authenticated X25519 Double Ratchet DMs and PBKDF2 sealed journal packets
Independent recovery CLI for every feature; pinned-block, reorg-checked, bounded readers everywhere
Reach (acting) vs Grip (receive-only, no exit function) vault split
Browser-side CREATE2 hook address mining with cancellation bound to form state
weaknesses: Host at 196,273/196,608 B (99.8%); new UI must go to trusted extensions evaluated via new Function
HTTPS reader and read RPC are acknowledged trust dependencies; archive hashes are not consensus proofs
No public-chain deployment; all numbers from local fixture and mainnet fork
Ratchet state, whisper keys and journals live only in browser IndexedDB
~200 KB data-URI tokenURI may be truncated by marketplaces; web3:// is the real surface
Cartridges have no network; everything through a 120 req/min bridge
20 boards remain incomplete per evidence limits
website_delivery: Host HTML built by tools/build-kernel.mjs (gzip + radix-85, DOMContentLoaded bootstrap with DecompressionStream) is published as raw ArchiveFactory chunk contracts (23,000 B chunks, 32/leaf, 16 leaves, 11,776,000 B max) and frozen once by PixelGardenKernel.freezeHost (src/PixelGardenKernel.sol:229; publisher-only, before first mint, <=196,608 B). document(id) (L247) returns the exact bytes + '<script>window.PIXEL_CONTEXT={...}</script></body></html>'; document(id,string) (L244) is the ERC-6860 overload for web3://KERNEL:CHAIN/document/ID/string!index.html; tokenURI (L799) -> ContentCartridge.gardenMetadata (src/cartridges/ContentCartridge.sol:79) returns a percent-encoded data:application/json whose animation_url is data:text/html;base64,<document(id)> and external_url is the web3:// address. A separate static HTTPS reader (web/launcher, dist/launcher.html + chunks + garden-sw.js) recovers the on-chain host via recoverGardenHost and refuses to run unless hostArchive().expandedHash === build-pinned __HOST_HASH__ (web/launcher/main.mjs:406), then swaps the DOM via DOMParser/replaceWith (L202-208) and re-creates scripts, never document.write. Large UIs are hash-pinned trusted workspaces; content cartridges run sandboxed in iframes with injected CSP.
wallet_gating: No login signature or backend. EIP-6963/window.ethereum provider, eth_accounts silently or eth_requestAccounts on gesture, chain id checked against PIXEL_CONTEXT (web/kernel/client.mjs:159). GardenClient.refresh() (L120) batch-reads ownerOf, custodyEpoch, account/grip, accountReady, displayName, visualSeed and throws 'Account binding failed' unless kernel.isCanonicalAccount passes for both Reach and Grip (L141-142; CREATE2 + exact ERC-1167 runtime hash, registry 0x000000006551c19487814612e58FE06813775758). owns = connected account === ownerOf (L153); owner-only controls render disabled otherwise. Every write goes through operation() (L206) which re-checks chain, account, custody epoch, cartridge activation epoch, simulates, then send() (L286) journals before broadcast. Authority is enforced on chain: kernel owner checks, ReachAccount authorized(epoch,msg.sender) on withdrawals/seals/sessions, custody epoch bump on every transfer. Public reads need no wallet; read-console is send-less and pinned-block.

pitfalls: document.open/write after wallet injection drops EIP-1193 listeners; swap DOM nodes instead
Loader-side global const collides with minified host; bootstrap declares nothing globally
Re-base64-ing the whole HTML inside tokenURI exceeds RPC gas caps; encode the envelope only
URL.port cannot carry chain ids > 65,535; parse web3:// host:chain manually
try/catch alone does not survive a codeless address; also check extcodesize
Validate room titles as UTF-8 and bound inline images and dependency recovery (codex fixes)
Transaction import must never overwrite locally tracked records (duplicate-mint hazard)
Hook mining must be cancellable on form change; CREATE2 salts must bind chain/kernel/garden/nonce
metadata.bytecodeHash:'none' is required for reproducible runtime hashes pinned in the kernel constructor
Trusted-workspace digests change whenever any UI source changes; frozen hosts and their archived clients must keep original builds
tests_and_tooling: node:test suites (test/*.test.mjs) against a Hardhat 31337 cancun fixture built by tools/fixture-kernel.mjs; npm run check = compile -> build -> fixture -> unit -> Playwright Chromium 153 browser suites (browser-launcher 339 lines, browser-kernel 793, browser-social 399, browser-otc 401) with a deterministic injected EIP-1193 provider auditing 24 workspaces at 320/390/768/1500 px; test/financial-fork.mjs (1,034 lines) and ens-fork.mjs against mainnet fork block 26,059,508; test/keeper-integration.mjs drives the systemd keeper CLI; tools/rpc-relay.mjs allowlists read methods for browser tests; CI .github/workflows/verify.yml runs two final-source jobs. Telling tests: 'package recovery rejects false full-payload hashes even when upload root is consistent', 'browser host recovery constructs the exact document from verified archive bytes', 'durable runner persists exact nonce before wallet access and blocks uncertain replay', 'wrong chain, changed snapshot, tampered payload and noncanonical receipt fail closed', 'native host extensions reject substituted bytes, paths and MIME', 'ratchet rotates both directions, consumes old keys and rejects replay', 'keeper signs only executeSale, journals before broadcast and recovers without a second submission', 'Garden URLs preserve uint256 IDs and chain IDs beyond the TCP port range', 'no issuance without the Garden owner or an exact delegated recipe'.
